item.title: LABOR SEC CHAVEZ-DeREMER: Trump tax cuts deliver bigger refunds and a big boost for working families
item.summary: The Labor Secretary says President Trump's Working Families Tax Cuts are driving historic savings with average refunds topping $3,400 this tax season.

item.title: Police flood Orange Crush island hot spot, warn of teen takeovers as beach bash madness returns
item.summary: Tybee Island braces for Orange Crush weekend with a heavy law enforcement presence amid concerns over unpermitted teen takeover events and gunfire.

item.title: Stefanik clashes with CNN hosts over Trump's Pope comments, while accusing Swalwell of 'criminal' conduct
item.summary: Rep. Elise Stefanik said President Trump is justified in engaging politically during wartime but argues Pope Leo XIV should avoid political involvement.

item.title: Nine dead, 13 wounded in second Turkish mass shooting in two days
item.summary: A 14-year-old boy allegedly shot and killed nine people at a Turkish middle school, the second school shooting in Turkey in just two days.

item.title: Former MLB prospect, 35, killed in car crash while returning from coaching tournament
item.summary: Former Houston Astros minor league prospect Jon Kemmer, who reached Triple-A, was killed at age 35 in a rollover car crash in Galveston County.

item.title: Duke suspends Students for Justice in Palestine following complaints over antisemitic Instagram post
item.summary: Duke suspended its SJP chapter after complaints about a flyer some claimed was antisemitic, depicting pigs with Stars of David and Israeli flags.

item.title: Hunter Biden now living abroad as legal troubles mount, court filing reveals
item.summary: A new filing shows Hunter Biden relocated abroad while battling a lawsuit over unpaid attorney fees.

item.title: UN filing accuses UK of forced displacement as Diego Garcia tensions and security fears grow
item.summary: UK PM Keir Starmer faces a crimes against humanity complaint at the UN over the alleged forced removal of Chagossian people from the Diego Garcia islands.

item.title: ODNI sends criminal referrals to DOJ for ex-IG, whistleblower tied to Trump impeachment
item.summary: Fox News Digital learned the Office of the Director of National Intelligence sent criminal referrals for the whistleblower whose allegations led to the 2019 impeachment of President Donald Trump.

item.title: ‘Yellowstone’ star Luke Grimes reveals outlaw country was 'no-go' in pastor father’s house
item.summary: Luke Grimes shares how growing up with a pastor father meant outlaw country music was only allowed on boys-only hunting trips away from his mother.
